architecturePatterns.requiredImports: function validateImports(fileContent) { const requiredImports = ['React', 'Next', 'Supabase']; return requiredImports.every(importName => fileContent.includes(importName)); }
architecturePatterns.fileStructureConventions: function validateFileStructure(filePath) { const regex = /^src\/(components|pages|api)\//; return regex.test(filePath); }
architecturePatterns.apiEndpointPatterns: function validateApiEndpointPattern(apiCode) { const pattern = /export\s+default\s+function\s+handler\s*\(/; return pattern.test(apiCode); }

integrationValidationRules.apiContractValidation: function validateApiContract(apiResponse) { const expectedKeys = ['status', 'data', 'error']; return expectedKeys.every(key => key in apiResponse); }
integrationValidationRules.databaseSchemaChecks: function validateDatabaseSchema(schema) { const requiredTables = ['posts', 'users', 'comments']; return requiredTables.every(table => schema.includes(table)); }
integrationValidationRules.componentInterfaceValidation: function validateComponentInterface(componentProps) { const requiredProps = ['title', 'content', 'author']; return requiredProps.every(prop => prop in componentProps); }

qualityThresholds.complexityLimits: function validateComplexity(code) { const maxComplexity = 10; const complexity = (code.match(/if|for|while|switch/g) || []).length; return complexity <= maxComplexity; }
qualityThresholds.performanceThresholds: function validatePerformance(responseTime) { const maxResponseTime = 200; return responseTime <= maxResponseTime; }
qualityThresholds.securityScoreMinimums: function validateSecurityScore(securityScore) { const minSecurityScore = 80; return securityScore >= minSecurityScore; }
qualityThresholds.architectureCompliancePercentages: function validateArchitectureCompliance(compliancePercentage) { const minCompliance = 90; return compliancePercentage >= minCompliance; }
